gems.name: Formulae
include: Construct neutral ionic compound formula from named ions or supplied charges
Explain lowest ionic ratio using charge balance
exclude: Recall or infer ion charges alone
Empirical or molecular formula from composition
gems.teaching_band_note: 5-6 monatomic; 7-8 polyatomic. Never replace source empirical band.

gems.name: Equations
include: Add or interpret assessed state symbols
Translate supplied named reactants and products or paragraph to formula equation
exclude: Use supplied equation for moles, redox, energy or equilibrium reasoning without assessed equation construction
gems.teaching_band_note: Activity bands are pedagogical; source empirical bands remain unchanged.

policy.primary: Directly assessed operation determines primary. Where mixed indivisible record chiefly assesses a subject, retain subject primary and add meaningful secondary. No mark splits.
policy.secondary: Retain subject context for reassigned records when chemically meaningful; add 16.2 for explicitly assessed equation component, not mere supplied equation use.
policy.inadequate: UNRESOLVED retains original primary/secondary. Never reopen source PDFs, mark schemes or images.
policy.pipeline_gate: PILOT_REVIEW_PENDING_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE; candidate inventory is not full-corpus remapping.
